data_trait_derive_macro_review.macros_and_failure: Only ordinary format! diagnostic generation and standard structural derives. Missing data/mismatch are Vec<String> observations, with no own panic/indexing/unchecked arithmetic or callbacks in these checks. cost_review: Let N be supplied source boundary rows, M maximum map/target-boundary size, K supplied coherence entries and T target name-set size. Each boundary row performs at most four borrowed-key tree lookups: O(N log(M+1)) key comparisons plus String equality/format byte costs. At most two diagnostic strings per row are output; those are required returned values, not redundant scratch clones.

Coherence inventory does two borrowed membership queries per provided pair: O(K log(T+1)) comparisons plus string lengths, and at most 2K diagnostic strings. BTreeMap iteration supplies deterministic ordering. No temporary owned tuple String key is allocated in either loop.

Constructor owns three supplied strings and creates empty maps. Accessors perform one borrowed-key tree lookup and allocate nothing. Structural Clone costs total record bytes and entries; equality/debug costs the visited structure/output bytes. No hidden parser, category-law evaluation, expanded-MIR guarantee, benchmark or allocator-totality claim.
